name: Snap Slash (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Sudden Strike class feature, Two-Weapon Fighting

Benefit(s): When wielding two light weapons, you may attack once with each as a standard action, an attack of opportunity, as part of a charge, or as part of a Spring Attack. Standard two-weapon penalties still apply.
